sources.anchor: Lookup an authorized account/key receipt BEFORE schema/content/safe-state validation.
Google verifies signature and required iss/aud/sub/exp/iat/nonce; GitHub GET /user
Unknown and expired receipts have the same 404 response.

scope: Independently authored synthetic expectations, not API results. Current application routes remain 503; no service/provider/browser acceptance is implied.

harness.storage: owned disposable storage only; never configurable real paths
harness.connections: independent PDO connections and independently bound synthetic sessions
harness.races: Instrument service phase barriers; every actor starts before the first finishes; each actor has a distinct connection and independently bound session where authenticated. Hold/release the indicated phases with bounded waits and cleanup, never timing sleeps or sequential HTTP calls. For races involving deletion, serialize its external ledger and live DB work with the same barrier.
missingInputs: private owned test account/session factories; never enable production auth bypass
actual transaction hooks for deterministic overlap
provider adapter rejection doubles separate from real provider acceptance
authored content registry and safe-position membership
unsafe semantic fixture registry with explicit world marker; this is not evidence that a server can observe omitted client UI

synthetic.identityExpected: Google/GitHub remain independent even if same email; display-name change does not change subject ownership
synthetic.deletionReceiptNotice: Deterministic 32-byte example is public fixture data, never a usable credential; production generates 32 cryptographically random bytes.

Problem.requestId: UUID; no invented stable problem code unless specified
